```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
met_dat <- read_csv("SraRunTable_full.csv")

```
```{r}
head(met_dat)
```

```{r}
met_dat_amp <-  met_dat %>% 
  filter(`Assay Type` == "AMPLICON")

head(met_dat_amp)
```


```{r}
# Save the SraTable with just the Amplicon sequences

write_csv(met_dat_amp, "SraRunTable.csv")
```

```{r}
met_dat_other <- met_dat %>% 
  filter(!`Assay Type` == "AMPLICON")

head(met_dat_other)
```

```{r}
mv_list <- met_dat_other %>% 
  select(Run) %>% 
    mutate(Run = paste0(Run, ".fastq.gz")) %>% 
  mutate

head(mv_list)
```

```{r}
# Save as a list to sort out the none amplicon sequences

#write_tsv(mv_list, "move_list.txt", col_names = F)
```
